modalText: The total percentage for {{sections}} should be 100%. Please adjust the values before saving.
modalTextMinMax: Select between {{min}} and {{max}} {{sections}}. Ensure the total percentage for {{sections}} equals 100%, with no field at 0%.

fields.name: name
fields.title: title
fields.price: a price (a number with up to 3 decimals, e.g. 2,304.500)
fields.numberOfPeopleNum: number of people, must be number
fields.orderParag: unique order value for each paragraph in content
fields.orderCont: unique order value for each content in blog
fields.dateOfDeathMustBeAfterDateOfBirth: date that isn't before date of birth
fields.quantity: quantity, must be a whole number
fields.warningQuantity: a warning quantity (whole number, not less than 0)
fields.criticalQuantity: a "has to be bought again" quantity (whole number, lower than the warning quantity)
fields.pib: a tax number (PIB) with exactly 9 digits
fields.registrationNumber: a registration number with exactly 8 digits
fields.phone: a valid phone number (digits, +, -, spaces, brackets)
fields.bankAccount: a bank account (18 digits, or in the form 160-0000002761287-85)
